scope.physics: Pinned PR147 collisionless non-tilted LRS finite 40-state model and three independent signed initial coordinates.
scope.method: Static derivation-to-code review; small deterministic array layout and three initial-model construction checks; readback of root-owned tiny wiring execution receipt.

equation_checks.reason: Initial concatenation is 40 parent entries followed by row-major (40,3) scaled tangents. The RHS uses the inverse reshape; variable-first solve_ivp output is transposed before (epochs,40,3) reconstruction. Independent distinct-column roundtrip checks passed.

T=Z diag(scales), T'=J T+F_A(A_theta diag(scales)); initial_tangents*SEED_SCALES and a_direction=amplitude_gradient*SEED_SCALES implement both factors. Unscaling uses the last parameter axis. Observable projection receives unscaled Z and unscaled amplitude_gradient, so direct A dependence is retained.

Source cosmology is extended to a_end=1/3. default_grid contains 121 x samples from0 to ln(21/5), followed by32 additional samples to ln7. Positive strict spacing, join index120 and 153 total were executed. z=21 exp(-x)-1 decreases20 to2. Tiny wiring covers only x0 to1e-4.

Equal atol=3e-13 applies to parent coordinates and scaled tangent coordinates. The corresponding unscaled absolute-weight terms are [3e-12,1e-9,3e-10] per parameter column; rtol is invariant under constant positive scaling. These are local adaptive solver weights, not componentwise global error bounds or derivative convergence certificates.

Ngamma0 index13 and Nnu0 index31 are correct for 4+4*9 coordinates. Both are initially1 and all three initial tangent entries are0. Checks use unscaled derivative units and source-compatible finite tolerances. u index3 remains0; tau sensitivity is retained.

observed columns are signed S,Pm,Pr,Ptotal and total is component sum. Norms are formed afterward. Initial three-coordinate identity uses the complete observable JVP, including direct A and H normalization. No norm derivatives at zero are stored or claimed.

All three listed coordinates are valid interior A/k inputs and differ from the completed pilot grid. Their full-range tangent jobs remain READY_NOT_SUBMITTED. The local tiny check at interior_1 is a distinct short interval and is not misreported as full-range completion.

Receipts preserve Physical HOLD, global_convergence NOT_RUN, production NOT_APPROVED. Parent code remains vendored and unchanged; the analytic finite-field implementation was separately compared to original RHS. No accuracy, closure, or convergence promotion follows from a successful wiring check.

reused_root_execution.limits: The comparison tests parent-state wiring on the stated short interval. It is not a finite-difference certification of evolved sensitivities over z20 to2.

findings.target: verify_wiring.py comparison before parent grid validation
findings.evidence: difference=arrays['raw_y']-parent.y.T is evaluated before parent.success and reached-grid checks. A partial-grid parent failure can raise a broadcast exception instead of recording the structured solver failure.
findings.impact: The observed successful two-IVP execution is unaffected and no false PASS was found. Failure diagnostics could be lost for a future failed parent check.
findings.recommended_change: Check parent.success and exact parent.t/grid and shape first. Compute difference only if comparable; otherwise store null and false checks with the parent message.

resolution.proof: Removing only the new parent_reached assignment and failure-return branch reconstructs the exact executed old bytes by SHA256. The successful path and all integrator calls remain byte-identical.
resolution.failure_branch: Parent success, exact t grid, and y shape are checked before augmented solve or parent comparison; failure writes FAIL_PARENT, null comparison, new_ODE_solves1, new_augmented_IVP0 and returns1.

review_helper_history: An initial inline review helper failed only while serializing numpy.bool_ into JSON; no solve was executed. The file-based helper converts to Python bool and completed. This is reviewer evidence tooling, not a product regression.
